newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares pare early gains to close down.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares pare early gains to close down.

text.p: Brazilian stocks pared early gains to close down slightly on hefty volume as investors scooped up profits, mostly in blue chips, from recent rising sessions, brokers said.
"In the morning, we saw strong buying pressure, especially on telecommunications and second-tier stocks, but the afternoon became very speculative. People took profits," a dealer told Reuters.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index .BVSP of 49 most-traded shares edged down 0.27 percent to close at 68.916 points on strong turnover of 698.5 million reais ($673 million).
